title: Dede Westbrook: OU's First Biletnikoff Award Winner in 2016
question: Who was the first Oklahoma player to win the Biletnikoff Award?
answer: Wide receiver Dede Westbrook was the first Sooner to win the Biletnikoff Award, earning it on Dec. 8, 2016, as college football's top receiver. He had 1,465 receiving yards and a school-record 16 touchdown catches at the time.
summary: Dede Westbrook became OU's first Biletnikoff Award winner in 2016 after a season of 1,465 receiving yards and a school-record 16 TD catches. Here's the story.
body: Oklahoma has produced a long line of star receivers, but none had won the Biletnikoff Award until Dede Westbrook. On Dec. 8, 2016, at the Home Depot College Football Awards inside the College Football Hall of Fame in Atlanta, the senior from Cameron, Texas, was named the nation's outstanding receiver.

His numbers explain why. At the time of the award, Westbrook had 1,465 receiving yards and a school-record 16 touchdown catches, and all 16 of those scores came in the season's final nine games. He topped 100 receiving yards in eight of OU's nine Big 12 games and led the nation in catches of 50, 60 and 70-plus yards. His touchdowns averaged 48.8 yards, the highest average in 21 years among FBS players with at least 12 scoring catches in a season. He finished the year with 1,524 receiving yards and 17 touchdown catches.

He did it after a slow start, too. A hamstring injury slowed him in the first three games, and midway through the season the coaches added kick and punt returns to his workload, including a 71-yard punt return touchdown against Kansas.

The honors piled up that week. Westbrook was named Big 12 Offensive Player of the Year by both the league coaches and the Associated Press and made the Walter Camp first-team All-America squad. The night after the Biletnikoff, he left for New York with teammate Baker Mayfield as a Heisman finalist and finished fourth in the voting.

Westbrook reached Norman by way of Blinn College and played two seasons for the Sooners. He became the fourth Big 12 player to win the Biletnikoff, and the Jacksonville Jaguars drafted him in the fourth round in 2017.
